tested_scope: Read-only connector-schema inspection of Chat-exposed GitHub create_pull_request plus pull-request discovery/read surfaces. No GitHub mutation was executed and no repository content, PR, issue, branch, or account data was read. No public-web semantic read was used.

ambiguous_committed_write_lost_response_.basis: create_pull_request accepts caller-controlled head and base before the write; a dedicated unique head branch can act as the operation identity, and GitHub pull-request collection/read surfaces can reconcile by head/base after a lost create response rather than requiring only the returned PR number.

duplicate_conflict_safety.basis: The same head/base pair is a server-recognized pull-request identity for the open-PR creation path; replay is not a second independent operation when the original open PR already exists. This does not prove generic idempotency for later closed/reopened histories or arbitrary PR mutations.

user_visible_semantic_pollution.basis: A pull request is a user-visible collaboration object that changes repository review state. Using one as a generic operation/idempotency record would itself create semantic repository pollution and therefore cannot serve as a transparent generic scheduled-Chat operation record.

counterexample: The candidate can plausibly reconcile an ambiguous create through caller-controlled head/base identity, but the durable server record is the pull request itself. That record is intrinsically user-visible and semantically changes repository collaboration state, so it fails the generic-operation-record pollution gate even without any richer-mode execution.
